notes.title: Better Joystick support
notes.content: WinterNovel support for controllers was improved a lot - now dpad is processed correctly. Try it! Recommended one is Xbox Controller.

notes.title: Simple Video Merger released
notes.content:
Simple Video Merger joins multiple videos together. Take some videos recorded on the same device and merge them into the single one. No setup, no options, no animation, just one video after another with a few mouse clicks! Few minutes of processing for a multiple hours of video. Fast and Simple.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2293350/Simple_Video_Merger/
